title: Promotion lift readout
question: Which promotions really raised sales, what did they net, and which should we scale, keep, change or stop?
story: Promotions added {incremental} in sales on {spend} of spend; {real} of them show a lift that is real.
questions: Which promotion netted the most after its cost?
Which channel stops responding to more spend?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, e.effect, e.lower, e.upper, e.p_value, e.roi, e.incremental_value, e.cost, p.channel, p.region, p.category FROM main.marketing.promo_lift_out AS o JOIN main.marketing.promo_lift_out__effect AS e ON e.intervention = o.entity_id JOIN main.marketing.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: effects
datasets.sql: SELECT e.intervention, e.metric, e.effect, e.lower, e.upper, e.p_value, e.incremental_value, e.cost, e.roi, p.channel FROM main.marketing.promo_lift_out__effect AS e JOIN main.marketing.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = e.intervention

datasets.name: series
datasets.sql: SELECT s.period, s.actual, s.counterfactual, s.lower, s.upper FROM main.marketing.promo_lift_out__effect_series AS s

datasets.name: steps
datasets.sql: SELECT 1 AS step, 'Sales added' AS label, e.intervention, p.channel, e.incremental_value AS amount FROM main.marketing.promo_lift_out__effect AS e JOIN main.marketing.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = e.intervention UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Promotion cost', e.intervention, p.channel, -e.cost FROM main.marketing.promo_lift_out__effect AS e JOIN main.marketing.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = e.intervention UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Net added', e.intervention, p.channel, e.incremental_value - e.cost FROM main.marketing.promo_lift_out__effect AS e JOIN main.marketing.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = e.intervention

datasets.name: curves
datasets.sql: SELECT p.channel, p.promo_id, e.cost, e.incremental_value FROM main.marketing.promo_lift_out__effect AS e JOIN main.marketing.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = e.intervention

kpis.label: Promotions with a real lift
kpis.expression: COUNT(CASE WHEN p_value < 0.05 AND lower > 0 THEN 1 END)

charts.title: Sales against sales without the promotions
charts.hint: The band is the range the model expects without any promotion.
charts.so_what: Weeks where sales sit above the band are lift you can credit to the promotions.

charts.title: From sales added to net sales
charts.hint: What the promotions added, less what they cost.
charts.so_what: If the net bar is below zero, the promotions cost more than they added.

charts.title: Sales added against spend
charts.hint: Each dot is a promotion: right is more spend, up is more sales added.
charts.so_what: Where the dots flatten out, more spend stops paying: cap spend there.

tables.title: Lift of each promotion
tables.hint: The lift, its range, whether it is real, and what it returned.
tables.so_what: Scale only what is real and pays back; stop what is not proven.

records.title: Scale, keep, change or stop
records.hint: Each promotion from the latest run with its lift; the ★ choice follows its net lift.
records.label: entity_label
